name: Rittō (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Rittō city emblem in white: an outlined stylised letter G-shaped device enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Rittō, a city in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 September 1961.

features.role: Rittō city emblem — an outlined stylised letter G-shaped device enclosing a ring
